result.title: Learning to Select Features with Manifold Deep Unfolding PCA
result.summary: Unsupervised feature selection (UFS) is of great significance in image processing and pattern recognition. Nevertheless, existing model-based methods often rely on manually tuned hyperparameters, while deep learning-based methods generally require massive training data. To address these issues, this paper proposes an efficient manifold deep unfolding feature selection network (MDUFS-Net). Technically, we first incorporate the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm into the classic principal component analysis (PCA) framework, then unfold the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based iterative algorithm into an end-to-end trainable network, thereby enabling automatic parameter learning. Moreover, a manifold optimization strategy is developed to improve the numerical robustness. On this basis, we further extend MDUFS-Net into an enhanced variant called MDUFS-Net+ by introducing the $\ell_{0}$-norm for more discriminative feature representations. Extensive experiments validate that our proposed MDUFS-Net and MDUFS-Net+ outperform state-of-the-art methods in the UFS task, with promising performance in clustering. Our code is available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/MDUFS.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MDUFS-Net：在 PCA 框架中引入 ℓ2,0 范数，将基于 ADMM 的迭代算法展开为端到端可训练网络以自动学习参数，并加入流形优化提升数值稳定性；进一步以 ℓ0 范数扩展出 MDUFS-Net+，在无监督特征选择与聚类任务上取得优于现有方法的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 把迭代优化展开成可训练网络、用稀疏范数做特征筛选，可能为 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态的逐步更新与视觉证据/特征筛选提供方法线索，具体对应关系可供核查。
